title: Raise the isolated pipeline command limit to 1500 s (decision D19)
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Hosted run 39477270644 on pull request #3 (b6a5b50): the new design-system job passed in about 3 minutes, but the foundation job timed out when ci:verify reached 900 s, after its 14 stages had taken 866 s (foundation 243 s, live-matches 347 s, browser 187 s, engine-browser 32 s). The pipeline step on the same D13 source took 698 s and 888 s in earlier hosted runs, so runner variance alone exceeds the old margin. Director decision D19: raise the limit to 25 minutes.

scripts/ci-local.py defines PIPELINE_TIMEOUT = 1500 and applies it only to the one isolated pipeline command (ci:verify or ci:design-system). The image build, frozen install, PostgreSQL start and cleanup keep their existing limits, and the Actions job limit stays at 30 minutes.

tests/ci/launcher.test.py asserts that the pipeline command receives PIPELINE_TIMEOUT and that it is 1500 s. RUN-20261020-038 (configuration and workflow checks, typecheck, lint, full suite: 399 Node, 26 Python, upstream 406/1 skip, 2 injection) passes at fingerprint 94cbd3d2.

RUN-20261020-039: isolated design-system suite passed in 107 s (30 gates, Chromium install, 150/150). RUN-20261020-040: isolated foundation pipeline passed all 14 stages in 545 s (484 Node, 26 Python, upstream 406/1 skip, 2 injection, 13 web Chromium, Lab workers). Both at fingerprint 94cbd3d2 through the changed launcher.
